description: FHIR R4 Practitioner resource — a person who is directly or indirectly involved in the provisioning of healthcare.

fields.label: Resource ID
fields.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource.

fields.label: Identifier
fields.description: An identifier that applies to this person in this role. May include NPI, license number, employee ID.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Whether this practitioner's record is in active use.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: The name(s) associated with the practitioner.

fields.label: Telecom
fields.description: A contact detail for the practitioner, e.g. phone number, email address.

fields.label: Address
fields.description: Address(es) of the practitioner that are not role specific (typically home address).

fields.label: Gender
fields.description: Administrative gender of the practitioner. Values: male | female | other | unknown.

fields.label: Birth Date
fields.description: The date of birth for the practitioner.

fields.label: Qualification
fields.description: The official certifications, training, and licenses that authorize or otherwise pertain to the provision of care by the practitioner.

fields.label: Communication
fields.description: A language the practitioner can use in patient communication.
